title: No 4-cycle, least top-form AND/OR circuit with one junk AND g: every top operand reaching g through ORs with nonempty S reaches a mixing gate reading g
formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → G.edgeFinset.Nonempty → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO G C →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm G C → ∀ (g : ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G C = {g} →
    (∀ a ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.tops G C, ∀ b : Fin 2,
      PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C a b) g →
      (PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a b).Nonempty →
      ∃ m ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.mixing G C,
        PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C a b) m ∧
        n + g ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C m).inputs)
plain_statement: G: graph with an edge and no 4-cycle; f_G: true when both ends of an edge are 1; C: fewest-gate f_G circuit of AND/OR gates reading exactly two earlier wires, no top inside an AND's cone; top: AND gate below f_G; g: the only AND not below f_G; S(w): inputs w reaches through OR gates; mixing gate: OR gate not below f_G with exactly one operand of empty S. Then every operand of a top that reaches g through OR gates and has nonempty S reaches, through OR gates, a mixing gate that reads g.
